title: CelTheo terrain profile (one event)
description: out/terrain/{id}.json. 2D profiles of real terrain along the line of sight, in a peak-anchored frame shared by both models. Arrays are parallel (same index = same sample). Values may be null where no elevation data covers a sample.

frame.description: origin at the peak foot, tangent plane at the peak. u = s − D. planar: x = u, z = h. globe: x = (R+h)·sin(u/R), z = (R+h)·cos(u/R) − R. R = WGS-84 normal-section radius along the azimuth; D = geodesic distance to the peak.

profiles.description: to_peak: along the geodesic to the peak. star_azimuth: along the star's azimuth at the occlusion time (the skyline that actually hid it). Both continue past the peak (settings.beyond_peak_m).

u_m.description: s − D. Use as planar x.

corridor.description: Optional 3D grid; null in this analysis.

planar_angle_deg.description: Rise-over-run angle from the observer to this sample.

globe_angle_deg.description: Globe geometric (unrefracted) elevation angle from the observer to this sample.
